Name: C2C_CONFIG_REQUEST_FAILED
Message: Firmware rejected the Ethernet configuration request or the configuration helper received a non-OK firmware status. No FLR is attempted; earlier chips may already have stored the override.
Recover / Troubleshooting Procedure: Inspect the firmware status and host/firmware compatibility; common-reset the tray before retrying to clear partially stored overrides.
Probable Causes: Firmware rejected or could not store the requested MAC/PHY configuration | Host and firmware configuration support differs

Name: C2C_CONFIG_FLR_FAILED
Message: All Ethernet override requests were stored, but the FLR helper returned an error while applying them. FEC readback was not attempted, so the requested configuration is unverified and this code alone does not diagnose hardware.
Recover / Troubleshooting Procedure: Inspect the FLR error, proxy health, and firmware recovery; common-reset the tray before rerunning configuration and link validation.
Probable Causes: RPC proxy or PCIe reset operation failed | Firmware did not become pingable within the post-FLR recovery timeout

Name: C2C_CONFIG_READBACK_MISMATCH
Message: After storing the override and completing FLR, one or more datalink pairs reported an unset FEC mode or a mode different from the requested value. All readback mismatches are included in the test message. This proves a configuration mismatch, not a link-quality or hardware failure.
Recover / Troubleshooting Procedure: Compare expected and actual modes, inspect firmware configuration application and competing resets, then rerun configuration and link validation.
Probable Causes: Firmware did not apply the requested mode to every datalink pair | A reset or another configuration request replaced the override

Name: HOST_NOT_REACHABLE_AFTER_BOOT
Message: The station host or its BMC did not answer ping or SSH after boot, so no module test could start. This is a test-system condition, not a module verdict.
Recover / Troubleshooting Procedure: Connect a monitor to the Devkit and verify that the system boots successfully, then try ping with host / BMC. Collect the suite/test logs and artifacts for this failure. Escalate to Etched engineer with the collected logs.
Probable Causes: Station host powered off or stuck before the OS came up | BMC network or management cabling fault | sshd not running or host key changed on the station host | Station host IP/DHCP reservation changed

Name: STATION_FIXTURE_SETUP_CHECK_FAILED
Message: Station fixture/setup check failed (Chroma telemetry / eval board power / vfio-proxy version query or mismatch / PEX version).
Recover / Troubleshooting Procedure: Collect the suite/test logs and artifacts for this failure. Escalate to Etched engineer with the collected logs. DO NOT retest.
Probable Causes: Station fixture or setup is not ready for module testing | vfio-proxy gRPC unreachable or reporting unexpected version

Name: PLX_DAEMON_NO_PEX_SWITCHES
Message: PLX daemon reported no PEX switches.
Recover / Troubleshooting Procedure: Collect the suite/test logs and artifacts for this failure. Escalate to Etched engineer with the collected logs. DO NOT retest.
Probable Causes: VBB MCU firmware is not updated to the required version | PEX switches are unavailable to the PLX daemon

Name: HOST_SETUP_STEP_FAILED
Message: A host driver/setup utility step failed: a kernel module reload, PCIe teardown or bus rescan, Kayak RAID remount, sohu_mdev sysfs parameter write, or log-reader activation returned non-zero on the station host.
Recover / Troubleshooting Procedure: Collect the suite/test logs and artifacts for this failure. Escalate to Etched engineer with the collected logs. DO NOT retest.
Probable Causes: sohu_mdev kernel module not loaded, or loaded at a version without the expected parameter | Missing sudo/permissions for the setup command on the station host | Earlier setup step in the suite failed and left the host in an unexpected state | Host tooling (driver package, log reader) not provisioned on this station | /sys/bus/pci/rescan write failed | Kayak RAID0 at /data/kayak failed to reassemble or remount after PEX teardown
Test Case: ReloadKernelModuleTestCase, PcieTeardownTestCase, PcieRescanTestCase, SetSkipFlrOnOpenCloseTestCase, SohuLogReaderActivateTestCase, LogReaderCaptureTestCase, PublishBootloaderTypeTestCase, KayakRaidRemountTestCase

Name: TEST_TIMEOUT
Message: A test case exceeded its configured timeout and was terminated by the harness before producing a verdict.
Recover / Troubleshooting Procedure: Rerun the affected subset once to check reproducibility. Route to engineering triage with the per-test log and timeout configuration.
Probable Causes: DUT hang or severe slowdown under the test workload | Test timeout configured too low for this platform | Harness/executor stall (e.g. remote connection loss)

Name: TEST_ARGS_INVALID
Message: A test case was invoked with invalid or unsupported arguments (e.g. unexpected kwargs, unsupported mode) and rejected the run before touching the DUT.
Recover / Troubleshooting Procedure: Fix the suite YAML for this test; do not route the unit to rework
Probable Causes: Suite YAML passes arguments the test does not accept | Suite YAML requests a mode/path the test does not support
Test Case: SohuSecureBootRecoveryUpdateTestCase, ServerNestedTestCase, SohuSnapTestCase, VfioProxyVersionTestCase, SohuWeightLoadTestCase, SltModuleNestedTestCase

Name: TEST_DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE
Message: A tool, binary, or data file the test depends on (e.g. the pldm_ua binary) is missing on the test system, so the test could not perform its function. Distinct from TH-CPU-0003, which covers a tool missing on the DUT. Also covers missing VBB flash runfiles / nm toolchain / version_info artifacts for fixture firmware update and chipsim /mnt/weights 9p mount failure for Kayak workloads that never start.
Recover / Troubleshooting Procedure: Fix the station deployment / harness package; do not route the unit to rework
Probable Causes: Test package/runfiles deployment gap on the station | Harness release missing a data dependency

Name: NESTED_SUITE_ORCHESTRATION_FAILED
Message: A nested suite failed to launch or complete orchestration (container image load, API ready/config, abort/shutdown, missing kv_store inputs, or resource wiring). Child test failures carry their own codes; the wrapper never mints this code for an inner suite that ran and failed. Unpopulated chip slots on SltModuleNestedTestCase remain SKIP (not this code).
Recover / Troubleshooting Procedure: Check suite config/resources; wrapper must propagate the first/most-severe child error code - never mint duplicate codes for child failures (test-system ERROR - excluded from yield)
Probable Causes: Suite configuration or resource wiring error in the nested wrapper | Child suite could not be launched at all | Container runtime / image load or inner harness API failure

Name: TEST_TOOL_EXECUTION_FAILED
Message: A test-owned command or binary failed to execute and did not produce a domain-specific DUT verdict.
Recover / Troubleshooting Procedure: Fix the station, image, or suite configuration; do NOT route the unit to rework.
Probable Causes: Test-system, station, or configuration problem covering Harness | Missing, malformed, or unreachable input required by TEST_TOOL_EXECUTION_FAILED | Suite or image provisioning gap rather than a DUT hardware fault

Name: TEST_METRICS_PARSE_FAILED

Name: TEST_FAILED_UNCLASSIFIED
Message: Catch-all - a test case failed (raised TestFailedError) without carrying a specific TH error code. Frequent sources should be migrated to dedicated codes (spec §9 taxonomy-health metric).
Recover / Troubleshooting Procedure: Follow the failing test case's own documentation/SOP. Open a taxonomy-gap ticket to allocate a specific code for this failure mode.
Probable Causes: Test case not yet migrated to specific TH error codes

Name: UNHANDLED_EXCEPTION
Message: Unhandled exception during test execution, wrapped by the harness (spec §11.2.2). The traceback is preserved in the per-test log.
Recover / Troubleshooting Procedure: Collect the suite/test logs and artifacts for this failure. Escalate to Etched engineer with the collected logs and traceback; do NOT route the unit to rework or FA.
Probable Causes: Bug in the test case or harness code | Unexpected environment state the test does not handle

Name: STATION_PSU_LOAD_IMBALANCE
Message: Station PSU load imbalance above 5% or PGOOD failure (fixture problem; excluded from module yield).
Recover / Troubleshooting Procedure: Known Devkit intermittent issue, retest once.
Probable Causes: Dev-kit chassis PSU degradation or imbalance | Station power cabling problem
